standard-dialogue.player: Huh... that's odd... I thought that would be big news.

standard-dialogue.npc: You thought what would be big news?

standard-dialogue.player: Well there seems to be an absence of a certain ornithological piece: a headline regarding mass awareness of a certain avian variety.
Oh have you not heard? It was my understanding that everyone had heard....
OH WELL THE BIRD, BIRD, BIRD, BIRD BIRD IS THE WORD. OH WELL THE BIRD, BIRD, BIRD, BIRD BIRD IS THE WORD.

standard-dialogue.text: There's a slight pause as Kree'Arra Jr. goes stiff.
